{{Short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=January 2025}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2023–24 |team=Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders |sport=Basketball |image=Middle Tennessee MT Logomark.svg |image_size=150 |conference=Conference USA |short_conf=CUSA |division= |record=14–19 |conf_record=7–9 |CoachRank= |APRank= |head_coach=[[Nick McDevitt]] |hc_year=6th |assoc_coach=Wes Long |asst_coach1=Logan Johnson |asst_coach2=Eric Wilson |asst_coach3= |stadium=[[Murphy Center]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2023–24 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team''' represented [[Middle Tennessee State University]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by sixth-year head coach [[Nick McDevitt]] and played their home games at [[Murphy Center]] in [[Murfreesboro, Tennessee]] as members of [[Conference USA]] (C-USA). They finished the season 14–19, 7–9 in C-USA play, to finish in a four-way tie for fourth place.{{Cite web |title=2023-24 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://conferenceusa.com/standings.aspx?standings=1135 |access-date=2024-10-31 |website=conferenceusa.com}} == Previous season == The [[2022–23 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Blue Raiders]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 19–14, 11–9 in C-USA play, to finish in fourth place.{{Cite web |title=2022-23 Men's Basketball Standings |url=https://conferenceusa.com/standings.aspx?standings=125 |access-date=2024-10-31 |website=conferenceusa.com}} They defeated [[2022–23 Charlotte 49ers men's basketball team|Charlotte]] in quarterfinals of the [[2023 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]]{{Cite web |last=Doughton |first=Sam |date=2023-03-09 |title=Weston's step-back three lifts Blue Raiders past Charlotte, to C-USA semis |url=https://goblueraiders.com/news/2023/3/9/mens-basketball-westons-step-back-three-lifts-blue-raiders-past-charlotte-to-c-usa-semis.aspx |access-date=2024-10-31 |website=Middle Tennessee State University Athletics |language=en}} before losing to [[2022–23 Florida Atlantic Owls men's basketball team|Florida Atlantic]] in the semifinals.{{Cite web |last=Doughton |first=Sam |date=2023-03-10 |title=Blue Raiders comeback bid falls just short in heartbreaking fashion against FAU in C-USA Semifinals |url=https://goblueraiders.com/news/2023/3/10/mens-basketball-blue-raiders-comeback-bid-falls-just-short-in-heartbreaking-fashion-against-fau-in-c-usa-semifinals.aspx |access-date=2024-10-31 |website=Middle Tennessee State University Athletics |language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
